sentences.full: Dr Darko and his gang wanted to destroy the city using the Star Diamond.
sentences.cn: Darko 博士和他的同夥想利用星之鑽石摧毀城市。

sentences.full: At midnight, they stole the diamond from the museum and ran out.
sentences.cn: 午夜時分，他們從博物館偷走了鑽石，然後跑了出去。

sentences.full: A man with long straight hair ran across the road.
sentences.cn: 一名留著長直髮的男子跑過馬路。

sentences.full: Another man with a round face ran down the pavement.
sentences.cn: 另一名圓臉男子沿著行人路跑去。

sentences.full: Power Girl used her power to find Dr Darko.
sentences.cn: 超能少女（Power Girl）運用她的超能力尋找 Darko 博士。

sentences.full: He was the man who was running into the subway.
sentences.cn: 他就是那名正跑進地下行人隧道的男子。
